
[yellow bold]-- DEPRECATION -- blink_rp2040.volt:2[/yellow bold]

Move `chip rp2040` to volt.toml: chip = "rp2040"

 [dim]1 |[/dim] 
 [dim]2 |[/dim] chip rp2040
 [dim]  |[/dim] [yellow]     ^^^^^^[/yellow]

[cyan]Hint: The chip declaration will move to volt.toml in a future version.[/cyan]


[yellow bold]-- HARDWARE WARNING -- blink_rp2040.volt:4[/yellow bold]

GP25 is the onboard LED on Pico. On Pico W, GP25 is used for WiFi SPI — not available as GPIO.

 [dim]3 |[/dim] hardware {
 [dim]4 |[/dim]     pin led: Output = 25
 [dim]  |[/dim] [yellow]        ^^^[/yellow]
